public.text: Leadership and governance is shown as addressed as a principle rather than a goal. This presentation may understate that leadership and governance are also capabilities and measurable health-system functions.
public.suggestedRevision: State that leadership and governance are cross-cutting prerequisites and implementation capabilities, even though they are not one of the seven outcome-oriented goals.
